benchmark.evidence_limit: Pair records retain the full reference output plus equality verdicts. Independent review checks that saved output against frozen REFERENCE. Separate optimized output arrays for each call were not archived.
benchmark.scope: Complete 4-key counts/bounds/owned-anchor kernel on one frozen existing joined SCENE buffer. Fixed local 5-pair sample with 5 calls per arm and zero warmups.

evidence_instrumentation.scope: Wrapper serialization/write/fsync row intervals and QA guards are included in actual outer costs. Ledger append, source setup and some publication gaps are outside their row intervals, so sums are partial instrumentation measures.

pixel_localization.temporary_array_scope: Named localization arrays only, excluding transient NumPy internals and shared count arrays. Process RSS is unmeasured.

limitations: Actual cold/hot/full times are single observations with source guards, three evidence wrappers and private QA snapshot guards. No whole-task A/B speedup has been measured.

nesting.pixel_localization: Contained in each readability interval; readonly load/PNG validation and state commit are separate siblings. Hot/full carry historical frame stages and are excluded from new computation totals.
nesting.service_capture: Host wrappers and QA checks are included in the actual request clocks. Inclusive spans and child stages are not additive.
nesting.world_descriptions: Contained in prepare; inherited index is a separate sibling. Do not attribute index time to world fields.

new_localization_work.scope: Named localization arrays exclude shared count arrays and transient NumPy internals. Python world-vector and coordinate-list cache object memory is unmeasured.

owned_process_lifecycle.server_termination_evidence_scope: Server FINISH, raw stdout EOF, and held venv-launcher wait/exit0/handle close. A separate held OS handle/return-code receipt for the distinct actual server PID is absent.

preparation_cost.scope: Environment/build receipts end before their JSON publication. The long observed span includes development and idle gaps and gives no continuous CPU-time total. Git/editorial/reference construction/independent review costs have no single complete task boundary here.

review_scope.operation: Read saved JSON/stdout/RX/PNG/NPZ and recompute arithmetic and hashes. Audit Python/NumPy/Pillow are outside the formal execution denominator.
